body:
N-39 FIX ROUND 2 on PR #119, 22 Nov 2026 (helper-n39s). Built, not walked. Fakes only: no device (A35 untouched, no adb), VM 108, homelab or network. 21 of the 23 new tests were seen RED on fdb3420 plus only the API stubs (the other 2 characterise correct code, mutation-checked).

1) BLOCKER (probe A), fixed at the source. ROOT CAUSE: stop() cancels only the songs held at the moment of the Stop. A song that becomes held LATER (its own pin removed, it joined a stopped release via pin(alongside:), a sync took it out of a playlist) kept its transfer; its failed/canceled word hit the stopped early return: row downloading, no task, place given away, stuck until the next app start. FIX: the invariant "a held song has no live transfer" is enforced in EVERY pass. _pump (end of every reconcile and completion) reads the held songs FIRST, before the no-connection and every-place-taken returns, parks the rows of held songs in flight (new DownloadsRepository.parkHeld, factored out of stopPins: one place knows what a held row is) and cancels through the same counted _cancelForStop (its canceled is the one acknowledgement owed, spent once). Second layer: a failed/canceled for a held song with nothing owed parks the row, cancels a task that still runs (the advisor's red case: an extra canceled for an id cancelled before gave 3 transfers at limit 2), frees the place, runs a pass; no back-off, nothing deleted. A finished file is the song. start() parks before it cancels (a refresh in flight is the old copy again).

2) WRONG DATA (probe B): the downloader keeps the quality a transfer was asked at WITH the task (metaData, like the path): TransferRequest.qualityId -> TransferUpdate.qualityId -> _onComplete records what the FILE is; the row's reading is only the fallback for a task with none (never a higher claim). Exact after a restart (replay test on the plugin's real Dart code; Kotlin Models.kt carries metaData: read, not run). No migration.

3) COSTS UNTIL N-45 (task id per attempt in the row; not built, not touched), in PB-44's walk row, PB-F22 and the PR: (a) Stop, Resume, app restarts before the acknowledgement: replayed canceled words read as outside cancels, both songs shown as not come (Interrupted before it finished., recorded The download was stopped) with a back-off while their tasks run; heals on completion; a back-off that expires first could start a task id twice. (b) Remove then a quick re-download: the removed attempt's last word is read as the new one's (not Stop-specific, hard to reach). (c) Stop then an outside cancel of the NEW attempt with the acknowledgement still owed: one counter cannot tell two canceled words apart; same end state (transient). (d) A lost canceled word leaves a stale memory entry: a later real complete spends it harmlessly, a later real failed is swallowed and the song stays downloading until the next start.

4) The lead's answers applied (mixed release reads Stopped + Resume whenever ANY song is held, said in PB-44; label; bool).

MUTATIONS (throwaway copy, one at a time, each caught by a named test): invariant after the connection check, after the places check, absent from the pump, rows not parked, place freed without cancel, uncounted cancel, stray word not parking / not running a pass / not cancelling a live task, start() not parking, cancel of every transfer, no second layer (failed, canceled), parkHeld no-op, finished file of a held song swallowed, refresh parked as queued; quality ignored / fallback changed / not handed to the transport / not carried / not read back. EQUIVALENT, not caught: the _estimates.remove calls (a stale estimate of an id not in flight is never read) and the held.isEmpty early exit (saves a query).

GATES: whole suite 3431 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed; dart analyze --fatal-infos, dart format, check.ps1 -Quick (hook), check_rows, check_order. origin/main (fc3fbd0) is in the branch. NOT DONE: the walk (PB-44 row extended); N-45, N-40, N-41, N-42 untouched; Arabic is N-41.
